summary: Inspect native session evidence and operate server-owned managed projection gates.

help:
Usage: native-sessions [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Inspect and operate Agent Hub-owned native session authority

Options:
  --install-completion  Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion     Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or
                        customize the installation.
  --help                Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  status      Read the content-free native capture and promotion state.
  acceptance  Record verified server acceptance; this does not activate...
  projection  Activate server-accepted managed projection or roll back in...
  prune-raw   Preview or apply an explicit raw-evidence retention cutoff;...
help.status:
Usage: native-sessions status [OPTIONS] {thread}

  Read the content-free native capture and promotion state.

Arguments:
  thread  [required]

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.acceptance:
Usage: native-sessions acceptance [OPTIONS] {thread}

  Record verified server acceptance; this does not activate projection.

Arguments:
  thread  [required]

Options:
  --canary-receipt <file>    [required]
  --identity-receipt <file>  [required]
  --gate-receipt <file>      [required]
  --help                     Show this message and exit.
help.projection:
Usage: native-sessions projection [OPTIONS] {thread}

  Activate server-accepted managed projection or roll back in one step.

Arguments:
  thread  [required]

Options:
  --mode <str>  [required]
  --help        Show this message and exit.
help.prune-raw:
Usage: native-sessions prune-raw [OPTIONS]

  Preview or apply an explicit raw-evidence retention cutoff; no default TTL.

Options:
  --project <str>      [required]
  --older-than <str>   [required]
  --limit <int range>  [default: 100; 1<=x<=1000]
  --apply
  --help               Show this message and exit.

usage.when: inspect durable native capture and promotion eligibility without contacting Codex

usage.cmd: st native-sessions acceptance THREAD --canary-receipt FILE --identity-receipt FILE --gate-receipt FILE
usage.when: verify retained runtime evidence and the current canonical ST acceptance gate before promotion
activate an accepted managed source or immediately roll back to rollout recovery

usage.cmd: st native-sessions prune-raw --project PROJECT --older-than ISO --limit N [--apply]
usage.when: apply an explicit owner retention cutoff while preserving pending, unresolved and conflict evidence
